title: Anyone experience strange background noise/music sometimes? Here's one strange one I actually remembered the lyrics to:
content: Ok so, this is maybe one of the strongest things I solidly remember from one of my "Mall World" dreams (though the "Mall World" environment in question for this particular dream was middle/upper middle class suburbs, best comparison I can make, which seems pretty random, is the neighborhood that the house that Helent Hunt's character buys towards the end of "What Women Want" is in. I was dreaming of walking around these suburbs at night time, I forget exactly what I was doing, usually it's searching for someone.. but it was drizzling slightly, and as I walked along, the following music swelled to a decent volume and just seems to come out of the sky - it sounded like a chorus of old, grumpy, angry men singing passionately but firmly, to the tune of Darth Vader/Imperial theme, they sang these words: *Rain, rain, rain, go away, go away,* *Rain, rain, rain, go away, go away!* *Go! To Missouri or Connecticut!* *But don't forget your predicate!* *Rain, go away, go away!* I know... I can't explain the song at all, but it was so strange, that this dream was over 20 years ago and I never forgot the lyrics or melody or how much sense it seemed to make to hear these grumpy old voices singing this song from the sky at the time.
